integrity: Proof relies on an explicitly cited classical inflation theorem; finite verification is supporting evidence and not an infinite proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The composition isomorphism is unrestricted for finite complexes; the displayed wedge splitting invokes the established vertex-inflation theorem for connected base complexes. It is not canonical equivariantly and is not an assertion that all summands are spheres.
title: Partition inflation and a composition law for iterated simplicial doubles
